standard.summary: 把 CPU-pinned 冻结权重以实验性低精度格式传输，再在 GPU 侧还原。
standard.effect: 目标是减少 PCIe 传输量，缓解低端卡 offload 等待。
standard.whenToUse: Streaming/offload 明显被 PCIe 卡住，且 benchmark 显示 FP8/INT8 格式有收益时尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存足够、PCIe 不是瓶颈、或追求完全保守质量时保持关闭。

standard_en.summary: Transfers the CPU-pinned frozen weights in an experimental low-precision format and restores them on the GPU side.
standard_en.effect: The aim is to move less data over PCIe and ease offload waiting on a low-end card.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth trying when streaming/offload is clearly held up by PCIe and a benchmark shows the FP8/INT8 formats help.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep it off when VRAM is sufficient, when PCIe is not the bottleneck, or when you want fully conservative quality.

optionDescriptions.off: No extra compression on the transfer format.
optionDescriptions.fp8_e4m3: Treated as FP8 while in transit.

advanced.principle: 冻结权重不参与梯度更新，可以在 CPU 侧预打包为较低精度传输格式，计算前在 GPU 侧解包。
advanced.intervention: 介入 CPU-pinned 冻结 Linear 权重的搬运格式，不应影响可训练 LoRA 权重。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能降低 PCIe bytes 和等待；收益依赖解压开销、batch 规模、prefetch 覆盖和总线带宽。
advanced.tradeoffs: 实验功能。低精度还原可能带来数值差异，默认不由自动增强开启，需用户显式选择或增强防护授权。

advanced_en.principle: Frozen weights take no part in gradient updates, so they can be pre-packed on the CPU side into a lower-precision transfer format and unpacked on the GPU before compute.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes in the transfer format of CPU-pinned frozen Linear weights and should not affect trainable LoRA weights.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May reduce PCIe bytes and wait time; the benefit depends on decompression overhead, batch size, prefetch coverage, and bus bandwidth.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Experimental feature. Low-precision restoration can introduce numerical differences; it is not enabled by auto-boost by default and requires explicit user opt-in or boosted-protection authorization.
